acceptanceCriteria: Current recovery decisions are revalidated against regular-file and filename boundaries, bounded size and duplicate-free JSON, repository and current Runtime identity, predecessor Contract/Summary/Outcome/Events digests, timestamp and decision shape, and exact successor Contract identity before Outcome projection or archive mutation.

Forged, foreign, stale, tampered, malformed, symlinked, oversized, digest-misnamed, or ambiguous current candidates fail closed with stable recovery_decision_invalid diagnostics and cannot move active artifacts or project superseded status.
Valid retry, successor, and supersede decisions remain usable while every binding is current, and deterministic candidate ordering selects only a fully validated latest candidate.
Historical archived Work Item bytes remain immutable and compatible; current Runtime identity checks do not retroactively reclassify historical recovery projections.

Only the shared Rust/test behavior from PR #192/#202 is selectively migrated; no WI-242/WI-248 archive, evidence, Outcome, events, recovery, finalization, or old lifecycle commit is imported or rewritten.

English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese workflow, command, Work Item, and parity documentation describe the current-read boundary and bind WI-255 to its exact future archive, verification, finalization, and close paths.
Focused recovery/archive/Outcome tests, documentation/governance gates, formatting, clippy, and the locked full workspace suite pass under installed Runtime verification.
goal: Outcome 与 archive consumer 在使用 current recovery candidate 前严格验证文件、JSON、repository、Runtime、predecessor artifacts、timestamp、decision shape 和 successor binding；invalid 或 ambiguous candidate 稳定 fail closed，历史 archive 保持兼容。
intent: 在最新默认分支上重新实现 current recovery decision 读侧重验，选择性迁移 PR #202/#192 已审阅行为，同时保持旧 WI-242/WI-248 archive、evidence、finalization 与 PR bytes 不变。
outOfScope: all WI-242 and WI-248 immutable lifecycle bytes
PR #192 and PR #202 branches or history
resource-finalization base binding already present on main

scenarioCoverage.expected: A Runtime-recorded current retry, successor, or supersede decision is accepted by Outcome and archive consumers only while every file, repository, Runtime, predecessor artifact, timestamp, decision, and successor binding remains current.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused recovery_decision lifecycle cases for valid retry, successor, supersede, Outcome projection, and archive behavior.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Foreign repository or Runtime identities, stale predecessor digests, invalid timestamps or decisions, and mismatched successor bindings fail closed before Outcome projection or archive mutation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run table-driven identity and predecessor/successor tamper cases and assert recovery_decision_invalid plus unchanged active artifacts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Symlinked, oversized, malformed, duplicate-key, digest-misnamed, and non-regular current recovery candidates fail closed with stable diagnostics.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Create real filesystem fixtures for each invalid candidate shape and execute Outcome/archive consumers against them.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Multiple current candidates are fully validated before deterministic latest selection; an invalid or ambiguous candidate cannot be skipped to authorize an older decision.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise canonical plus digest-suffixed candidates with timestamp ties, invalid newer entries, and filename/content digest mismatches.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Historical archived Work Items retain immutable bytes and historical projection without enforcing a later Runtime identity as a retroactive current-read rule.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run existing recovery, archive_integrity, outcome_report, and full repository suites against archived historical fixtures.
